run_detokenize_files: run the detok script to detokenize tokenized text files using Moses detokenizer
run_detokenize_compressed: run the detok script on compressed input files with automatic decompression support
run_detokenize_stdin: run the detok script with no file arguments to detokenize text from stdin
refactor_detok_replacements: refactor the detok script to add custom token replacement rules for special characters
review_detok_main: review the detok script main function to understand the Moses detokenization pipeline
